coaching.headline: Another lopsided win: the duo lane and jungle snowballed early, and seven towers to one sealed it.
coaching.team: Murdock and Phase ran away with the duo lane, taking first blood and five of six early deaths their way instead of ours. Belica never died despite an unfavored mid lane, and Zarus's offlane matchup swung from theirs early to ours late. The team kept winning fights even while trading a Fangtooth away, turned most of those wins into towers, and closed it seven towers to one with more than double the enemy's objective damage.

focus.title: Defend the tower after the team wins the fight
focus.evidence: At the fight that went three kills to none in our favor near our Outer Tower, nobody on our side was dead beforehand, yet the tower still fell soon after the fight ended.
focus.action: The team converted seven of nine won fights into an objective within ninety seconds, so losing the tower right after a fight win was the exception worth stopping.

perPlayer.78c58fb9-a3cb-44bd-99e5-9a08a16ece1c: Khaimera's stat line was excellent: twelve kills, team-leading damage well above the jungle norm, and only three deaths. One blemish: a solo death to their carry early, one of two caught-out deaths we gave up all game. At the Mini Prime fight where the team fought two kills down, Khaimera wasn't among the credited kills or deaths; that is exactly the fight to force the jungle lead into next time.
perPlayer.7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b: Dying first in three of the game's fights is the number to fix for Phase. Let a frontline teammate take the opening hit before stepping into the next contested fight. Everything else was support work done right, strong healing, zero carry deaths before the ten-minute mark, and a duo lane that buried Argus and Legion early.
perPlayer.55ce8bb7-8577-43b5-a6ea-a62219fa5447: Lt. Belica never died all game despite an unfavored midlane matchup against Iggy & Scorch, and CS stayed healthy too. The number to fix is damage, well under the midlane norm, and the build tells part of that story: Combustion and Wraith Leggings never got finished in favor of Orb of Enlightenment and Megacosm. Chase the recommended core next time and that zero-death discipline should start converting into kills.
perPlayer.10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Zarus's only death came from getting caught alone by Aurora, in a matchup that favored them early before swinging to us late. Everything else was clean: the full recommended core and just one death across the whole match. Stay near a teammate while that matchup is still contested next time instead of walking into their favored window alone.
perPlayer.a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e: Murdock was the best story of the night: first blood on their support in the opening minutes, twelve kills, and damage well above the carry norm on the exact recommended core. All three deaths came inside team fights rather than alone, including the one next to Phase right before their Fangtooth. Keep running the favored lane into a full build, and when a won fight still costs the objective, trade back instead of pushing past it.

22.4.call: Four kills to none right as we cracked their Inhibitor. Keep grouping and pressing like that once a structure is already breaking.

18.6.call: Trading bodies for their Fangtooth was a fair exchange since we won that fight three kills to two, but it only pays off if the team turns around and cashes the advantage somewhere else right after.

78c58fb9-a3cb-44bd-99e5-9a08a16ece1c.build: Khaimera finished the full recommended core of Sky Splitter, Ashbringer and Onixian Quiver, then added Imperator on top, and the damage and kill numbers back that build up. Against this 3-magical enemy comp that core still carries zero magic resist, the one gap worth covering next game.
78c58fb9-a3cb-44bd-99e5-9a08a16ece1c.eternal: Thraex's sustained-basic-attack mark suits Khaimera's stick-and-duel style well.

7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.build: Phase stopped at Prophecy and Tainted Scepter instead of the Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves core, but the carry stayed untouched early and the healing output was strong regardless. The build is not the issue tonight.
7c8ab99c-31c5-4ea5-a6fa-e0d6417c3f1b.eternal: Lotus's random stat roll is a generic choice for an enchanter support rather than one built around Phase's Link-and-heal plan.

55ce8bb7-8577-43b5-a6ea-a62219fa5447.build: Combustion's burst damage and Wraith Leggings' bonus damage to low-health targets are built for closing out kills; Orb of Enlightenment and Megacosm traded that burst for sustain, which lines up with Belica's damage finishing well under the midlane norm.
55ce8bb7-8577-43b5-a6ea-a62219fa5447.eternal: Belica's Lotus pick leaves the major to a random roll instead of guaranteeing the damage or haste a burst mage actually wants.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.build: Augmentation's empowered attack after each ability cast, Mutilator's percent-health on-hit through every ability, and Basilisk's stacking armor shred all suit Zarus's dive-and-stick kit, backing the full recommended core Zarus finished this game.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a.eternal: Marrow's heal-off-hero-damage major fits Zarus's in-the-fight duelling style.

a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.build: Murdock finished the exact recommended core, Lightning Hawk, Vanquisher and Imperator, the build sitting at a 53% win rate, and his twelve kills back it up.
a412baf3-dd17-4f89-8ecf-9d0704f3a79e.eternal: Vermis rewards sustained basics on one target, a solid fit for a marksman in a favored matchup against Legion.

threats: Chain-CC risk (2 hard-CC abilities, ~1.0s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Iggy & Scorch Inferno (knockback). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Ambush leap → Unleash AS → Cull stun, Invigorate to cleanse+heal
ourKits.winCondition: stick on one target, stun with Cull and out-sustain via Spirit Regen
ourKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his Cull stun
ourKits.playAgainst: ANTI-HEAL is mandatory — it guts his whole kit; kite the leap and CC through Invigorate

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link an ally → Psychic Flare blind → Energy Lance → Hyperflux buff ult
ourKits.winCondition: buff a hyper-carry through the Link and Hyperflux for a teamfight
ourKits.passive: abilities heal her and her linked ally
ourKits.playWith: the strongest carry to Link and supercharge
ourKits.playAgainst: kill the linked carry, not Phase; break the link timing

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Evade in → Barricade block → Spear of Nyr (execute <20%) → Coliseum ult arena
ourKits.winCondition: trap a target in Coliseum and out-duel with stacked Gladiator
ourKits.playWith: a team that joins him inside the Coliseum
ourKits.playAgainst: don't fight him in his arena — disengage; burst through Barricade's window

ourKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
ourKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
ourKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
ourKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
ourKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

enemyKits.combo: Oil Spill → Molotov ignite → Flame Turret → Inferno knockback ult
enemyKits.winCondition: layer fire zones on a choke/objective and burn the team
enemyKits.playWith: CC that holds enemies in his fire
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't fight in his zones — flank; kill the turret, dive him

enemyKits.combo: Boreal Sweep slow → Hoarfrost root → Glacial Charge engage → Cryoseism stun ult
enemyKits.winCondition: chain frost CC (slow→root→stun) to lock the fight down
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her long CC chain into kills
enemyKits.playAgainst: she's a CC battery — cleanse/QSS the Cryoseism stun; spread to avoid the chain

enemyKits.combo: Dread Nova stun → Ether Crystal push/lift → Particle Shredder channel → Synaptic Obliterator beams
enemyKits.winCondition: poke from max range and zone with the crystal
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline to protect his stationary channel
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Dread Nova; dive him during the immobile ult channel
